iface.help: Network interface for standalone mode, or the iface tag on emitted Ethernet frames when gateway-resident

standalone.help: Open the plugin's own AF_PACKET socket and RX thread. Leave false inside a gateway; the core FrameSink is the only wire path

max_retries.help: Maximum retransmission attempts before giving up

max_connections.help: Maximum simultaneous connection state entries (SYN-flood guard)

max_receive_buffer_entries.help: Maximum out-of-order receive-buffer entries per connection

max_receive_buffer_bytes.help: Maximum out-of-order receive-buffer bytes per connection

rx_window.help: Advertised receive window size in bytes

isn_seed.help: Starting initial sequence number for accepted connections (deterministic, not random)

keepalive_idle_ms.help: Idle time before the first keepalive probe, in milliseconds

keepalive_interval_ms.help: Interval between keepalive probes, in milliseconds

keepalive_retry_count.help: Keepalive probes sent before the connection is considered dead
